title: ATTP events calendar 2023-2024
body_html:
At last!

At the end of last week, the long-awaited ATTP calendar of national sporting events for the 01.07.2023-01.07.2024 season was approved by a unanimous decision of the ATTP Council.

The ATTP calendar of national sporting events is drawn up in line with ATTP’s tasks and objectives for developing and promoting professional and amateur table tennis in the Republic of Moldova across different groups and age categories of the population, including people with disabilities and people with reduced physical capacity.

This season marks the start of a new era for table tennis in the Republic of Moldova, in which the SUPER CUP and MASTERS ATTP tournaments will become the most popular and anticipated events among all table tennis fans in the country.

The conditions for holding the sporting events in the Calendar are set by the Regulations for each competition, drawn up in accordance with ATTP’s general requirements for preparing regulations for competitions held under its auspices.

Oversight of the events planned in the Calendar is entrusted to the ATTP Council (Executive Bureau).

If the date or venue of competitions changes during the year, the ATTP Council reserves the right to make the necessary amendments and additions to the Calendar on the basis of proposals duly submitted.

The ATTP sporting events calendar sets out five competition formats:

(blue) regular table tennis tournaments on the SETKA CUP platform,

(yellow) seasonal national SUPER CUP ATTP tournaments

(white) the annual ATTP MASTERS series tournament (TOP-18)

(green) national memorial tournaments

(grey) TOP CUP Academy leagues

The structure of the Calendar includes the following sections:

a) name of the event;

b) number of participants;

c) age category of participants;

d) date and venue of the event.
